body:
## What & why

Delegated stream accounting currently parses each `data:` line as a complete JSON document. A conforming event whose JSON spans multiple data fields loses token counts; Responses and Messages can also acquire a false appended error and a failed history record even though the upstream stream completed.

Assemble the data fields with LF and account the event at its terminating blank line, following the [SSE parsing rules](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#parsing-an-event-stream). Preserve LF, CRLF and CR boundaries across HTTP chunks, keep incomplete EOF data uncommitted, and discard comment-only heartbeats without retaining an event buffer. Valid upstream response bytes remain unchanged.

## Area

- [x] Engine, CLI or server (`edge0-infer/`)

## How was it tested?

Linux CPU on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 26.04 / GCC 15.2, with the exact four production files in this branch:

- Native regression: three protocols × three line endings × four chunk sizes, plus incomplete EOF and comment-only heartbeats.
- Real native proxy + HTTP fixture: 15 cases. Original main and the existing #255 error-handling patch each fail the same 12 cases; this change passes all 15. Three single-line controls pass throughout. Valid streams remain byte-for-byte identical.
- `cmake --preset cpu && cmake --build --preset cpu`
- `ctest --preset cpu --no-tests=error --output-on-failure -L "L0|L1"`: 98 runnable passes, 3 device skips, and 3 reproduced baseline failures (`platform_memory`, `ordered_json`, `template_tools`).
- `ctest --preset cpu --no-tests=error --output-on-failure -L L2 -R strata`: 2/2 pass.

An earlier final-suite attempt also hit the untouched slots test. With the entire native source tree restored to main, its assertion reproduced in 1/300 runs at four-process concurrency (0/100 serial); the unchanged weights assertion reproduced in 2/100. The slots binary hash stayed identical after restoring this patch. Both tests passed in the final complete suite; these failures are preserved in the evidence.

[Original / #255 HTTP controls](https://github.com/Afloat16/Edge0/actions/runs/43963750094) · [Final Linux verification and pristine baseline](https://github.com/Afloat16/Edge0/actions/runs/43967469449/job/133650571284).

macOS did not run: its queued job was cancelled before executing steps. Keep this proposal as a draft pending the repository's macOS checks. No GPU or device execution is claimed.

- [ ] Full L0/L1 passes: the three unchanged Linux baseline failures above remain.
- [x] Ran the affected higher-level delegated tests.
- [x] Added regression tests for the changed behavior.
- [x] Documentation checked; the existing protocol contract is unchanged.
